name: skills-workspace
description: Workspace root for buildable apps that live alongside the skills. Skills themselves stay buildless and install straight from their directory.
//type: Deliberately NOT "module". This package.json sits at the repo root, so its type field governs every .js file beneath it - including the 51 CommonJS verification scripts in terrain-architect/studio, which use require() and would all fail with 'require is not defined in ES module scope'. ESM is declared in apps/terrain-studio/package.json instead, where it only governs the app.
